subject: general
question: Who among the following was NOT a member of Simon Commission?
solution:
The correct answer is __**James A Scott**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Simon commission:

 
 
• The British government appointed the Simon Commission in 1927.
 
• The commission arrived in British India in 1928.
 
• The Commission published its 2-volume report in May 1930.
 
• The commission is popularly known as the Simon Commission after its chairmanship of Sir John Simon.
 
• Protest in Lahore against Simon's commission leads to the death of prominent Indian nationalist Lala Lajpat Rai.
 
• The Government of India Act 1935 was the outcome of the Simon Commission.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Clement Attlee who later became Prime Minister of Britain came to India as a member of Simon Commission.
 
• The British government appointed the Simon Commission to review the Government of India Act 1919 in the year 1927.
 
• The Simon commission arrived in India in 1928.
 
• It was formed to study constitutional reforms and make recommendations to the government in India.
 
• Simon commission was an all-white commission without any Indian members.
 
• The commission consisted of seven Englishman and sir John Simon was its chairman.
 
• It was formed on 26th November 1927.
 
• Simon commission arrived in India on 3rd February 1928.
 
• The Madras session of the congress passed a resolution to boycott the Simon Commission.
 
• Simon commission submitted its reports on 27th May 1930.
